instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Humans need to eat food in order to survive. This fact will most likely never change. How we get our food, however, has changed significantly in the last 10,000 years. Humans can eat many things. For example: fish, vegetables, meat, fruit or nuts. All of this and more has been part of our diet for millions of years, but about 10,000 years ago, there was a major shift in the way we get our food. Instead of being hunter-gatherers, many people all around the world invented farming and started to cultivate the land.

Hunter-gatherers ate many different things depending on what they could find in each season. They essentially hunted and gathered the food they could find in their surroundings. Certain foods were not available throughout the whole year, so sometimes hunter-gatherers had to travel great distances to get enough food. The invention of farming changed this though.

The establishment of farming changed the human diet. From then on, people began to eat the same kinds of foods — namely the crops they had planted. This shows that the way we get food and what we eat is constantly changing.

atoms.a: According to the text, what fact will most likely never change?
b: ++The fact that humans have to eat food in order to survive.
The way we cook our food.

atoms.a: What changed significantly in the last 10,000 years?
b: ++The way we get the food we eat.
How often we eat food a day.

atoms.a: What effect did farming have on the human diet?
b: ++Humans began to eat more of the same kind of food.
++People who hunted and gathered the food they could find in their surroundings.
People who farmed huge areas of land.
People who grew flowers and plants.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarises the text the best?
b: ++This text is about how the invention of farming changed the human diet.
This text is about the importance of time.
This text talks about what the best human diet is.

feedback.end: Try to remember the main topics of this text. There are some questions about it in the next level too.
